description.value: Lighthouse Marine Park is a 24-acre oceanfront park operated by Whatcom County, perched at the 49th parallel on the southern tip of the Tsawwassen Peninsula in the US exclave of Point Roberts. It is widely regarded as one of the best land-based spots to watch orca whales from shore, with views across the Strait of Georgia toward Mount Baker. The park offers a main campground plus five group camp areas, a 2-mile connector trail network, beach access, picnic areas, and a playground — making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the Vancouver Crossing Loop through Point Roberts.

No hiker/biker-specific sites, showers, or most other amenities are mentioned by name on the website, so those remain null.
concerns: Park is located in Point Roberts, WA, USA — a US exclave accessible overland only through Canada. Cyclists must cross the US border to reach it. This is likely intentional given the route_slug 'vancouver-crossing-loop', but directory users should be aware of cross-border logistics.
